objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with recurrent skin lesions, recurrent infections, and failure to thrive.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’ve had skin spots since I was very little, and some have pus. I also get sick with colds a lot, my lymph nodes get bigger, and I have fevers often. My eating and growing aren’t very good.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin excoriations—such as areas where the skin is scratched raw, has small open spots, or looks irritated from scratching—anywhere on your body? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor. I don’t think my skin looks scratched raw or irritated from scratching—I just get different spots that sometimes have pus.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you have pauses in breathing during sleep (for example, someone says you stop, or you wake up gasping)?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t been told that I stop breathing or have pauses when I sleep, and I don’t wake up gasping.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—after that minor injury I didn’t have severe pain, swelling, bruising, or any trouble using the area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (for example, a red patch or skin that feels hot compared with the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—on my left wrist I haven’t noticed redness or skin that feels warm compared with the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the skin of your chest), especially after an injury or from coughing/strain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor. I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall—no dark or discolored areas, even after coughing or any injury.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor. I haven’t been needing to pee more often, and I don’t think I’m making bigger amounts of urine.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor. I don’t use any substances like alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, or other drugs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had trouble controlling my urine, and I don’t leak or miss making it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even if they were mild or only happened once)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any nosebleeds recently, even mild ones.”
